pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THIS IS OUR OWN THING WE GOT HERE! IT'S GONNA STAY OUR OWN THING!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHEN WE DO BUSINESS WITH SOMEONE LIKE DINO, IT’S ON EVEN TERMS!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: HE CAN'T BE TRUSTED EXCEPT TO TRY AND PUT A COLLAR ON YOU, UNDERSTAND?!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: BUT IF YOU WANT TO ROLL OVER FOR HIM...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...AT LEAST SHOW ME ENOUGH RESPECT NOT TO BEG MY FUCKING PARDON.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ISN'T THAT RIGHT, ARTHUR?

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: HEY, YOU’RE THE BOSS.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: I'VE GOT NO COMPLAINTS

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THAT KEEPS THINGS NICE AND SIMPLE FOR ME

pages.speaker: character9
pages.text: IF YOU REALLY MEAN IT...

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: HE KNOWS.

pages.speaker: character12
pages.text: MAN, BUT LIKE, SAY ASH'S SLIPPING.

pages.speaker: character12
pages.text: COULDN'T EVEN TAKE THOSE TWO FOOLS OUT.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: FUCK- HEAD.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: WHAT YOU THINK-- HE KEPT MISSING?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HUH?

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: HE CALLED THOSE SHOTS LIKE BILLIARDS.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: IF HE WANTED ‘EM DEAD, IT’VE BEEN ONE, TWO.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: BUT HE TOOK HIS TIME... CHUNK OUT THE CHEEK, LITTLE PIECE OFF THE SHOULDER...

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: FROM TEN YARDS OFF, WITH A SHORTENED .357...

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: NO. THERE AIN'T NO WAY TO BEAT HIM IN A FAIR FIGHT.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: MARVIN CALLED HIM A PUNK? DUDE DOESN'T KNOW SHIT ABOUT HIM EITHER. ! I RECALL YOU NOT TOO WISE ONE TIME ON ASH YOURSELF.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: WELL, YOU MIGHT SAY HIS GOOD LOOKS CLOUDED MY JUDGMENT.

pages.speaker: character6
pages.text: IGOT THESE FINGERS TO REMIND ME TO GIVE HIM THAT GENTLE TOUCH OF PAYBACK.
